U-CCF01.title: Build DieCavitySketcherEngine — parametric 2D profile generator for 5 die geometry types
U-CCF01.description: Engine that accepts die cavity type (MailBox, Altracs, Taptite, Heading Die, Squares) and dimension parameters (up to 34 per the existing Excel system: length, width, depth, corner_radii[4], draft_angle, chamfer_width, chamfer_angle, counterbore_diameter, counterbore_depth, step_count, step_depths[], step_diameters[], land_width, relief_angle, nose_radius, thread_pitch, thread_depth). Outputs: (1) SVG path data for the 2D cross-section profile, (2) dimensioned annotation overlay with leader lines and callout text, (3) profile_area and perimeter for downstream volume calculation. Each die type has a characteristic cross-section template: MailBox=rectangular with corner radii, Altracs=lobular with alternating arcs, Taptite=trilobular, Heading Die=circular with stepped counterbore, Squares=square with chamfered corners. Delegates to existing SketchEngine for primitive operations (sketch_create, sketch_add_entity). Validates dimensions against manufacturing limits (min wall thickness 0.5mm, max aspect ratio 10:1, draft angle 0.5-15 degrees).
knowledge_consult: JM Die geometry types from tribal knowledge

phases.title: 3D Preview Generator — Three.js Cavity Visualization + CSG

U-CCF03.title: Build DieCavity3DGeneratorEngine — extrude 2D profiles to 3D meshes with CSG boolean subtraction
U-CCF03.description: Engine that takes DieCavitySketcherEngine profile output and generates 3D geometry: (1) Extrude 2D cross-section profile along Z-axis by cavity depth to create cavity solid, (2) Generate stock blank (cylinder for round dies, rectangular block for square) with configurable oversize, (3) CSG boolean subtract cavity from stock to produce the die body, (4) Apply draft angle by tapering the extrusion (linear interpolation of profile scale along depth), (5) Add counterbore steps as concentric cylinder subtractions at specified depths, (6) Generate corner fillet blends as swept arcs along vertical edges, (7) Output Three.js-compatible BufferGeometry (vertices, normals, indices) plus wireframe edge data for dimensioned overlay. For Altracs trilobular profiles: revolve the lobular cross-section. For Heading Dies: lathe-revolve the stepped circular profile. Volume calculation from mesh for material cost estimation. Performance target: < 200ms for 50K-triangle mesh generation.
knowledge_consult: hyperMILL SDK om.cad.core namespace (boolean, shape, electrode patterns)
exit_criteria: Generates valid 3D mesh for all 5 die cavity types

Tests assert specific vertex counts, volume values, and bounding box dimensions

U-CCF06.title: Forge-Triple: cavity-geometry-integrity hook + die_sketcher dispatcher actions + /die-sketch skill
